user_direction: 先校准评估，按原策略股票池和规则复现公开基准，再核对真实交易条件；不扩策略。
benchmark: Kenneth French US monthly Momentum (Mom), six size-by-prior2-12 value-weight portfolios
universe: NYSE/AMEX/NASDAQ historical eligible stocks under original CRSP rules; no ARK-only, ETF or present-day survivor substitution
window_reason: All complete calendar months in the existing stock evaluation; June2024 stops June26 and cannot be compared with the authors full June monthly return.
aggregate_check_window: All same-vintage common complete monthly rows; preserve any exclusions with reasons.
return_units: Published percent; use Decimal strings. Factor PnL is not funded-account CAGR.
tolerance_rule: Per-row rounding bound: sum(abs(weight)*0.5*10**(-published_decimal_places)) plus factor rounding half-unit, capped at0.015pp. No post-result widening.
negative_controls: shift reference by one calendar month

phase_acceptance.A_public_component_reconstruction: Same-vintage value-weight six-portfolio factor matches every common month within frozen rounding bound; negative controls rejected. This does not certify stock membership or security-level formation.
phase_acceptance.B_stock_level_replication: Acquire legally usable same-vintage CRSP security-level history, identities, shares, exchange/security status, total-return and delisting treatment; construct official eligible universe, NYSE breakpoints, lagged value weights and compare monthly constituents/returns. Missing inputs remain blocked, never replaced by public portfolio output.
phase_acceptance.C_real_execution: Use named actual broker/account rules, dated fees, buying power/settlement, short/borrow/collateral and fills; reconcile decision/order/cash/inventory. Standard T+1 alone is not an account receipt.

additional_scope_budget.financial_budget_note: User-authorized new calibration scope; preserve earlier24 evaluations and count any newly executed financial paths explicitly, not as zero-cost internal tests. No B/C financial evaluation until required input contracts pass.
